title: Unearths IFNB1 immune infiltrates in SOP-related ossification of ligamentum flavum pathogenesis.
summary: Machine-learning feature selection prioritized IFNB1 among OLF/SOP candidate genes; transcriptomic analyses and expression checks during osteogenic induction support a narrow candidate association, not a demonstrated causal mechanism. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: LASSO and SVM-RFE feature selection helped select the core genes linked to the represented IFNB1 result.

evidence.tested: Machine-learning feature selection prioritized IFNB1 among OLF/SOP candidate genes; transcriptomic analyses and expression checks during osteogenic induction support a narrow candidate association, not a demonstrated causal mechanism.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
